metadata.title: The inf spectrum of moduli space
metadata.abstract: Given a surface of genus $g \geq 2$, its inf spectrum is the ordered multiset of inf lengths of curves on the surface, the infimum being over all hyperbolic metrics. We show that the inf spectrum has exponential growth with coefficients that only depend on g, improving the earlier double exponential upper bound. The proof involves developing a number of tools including the process of "thickening" a surface and the notion of model surfaces. These tools may be of independent interest.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 模空间 inf 谱指数增长
analysis.workSummary: 对亏格 g≥2 的曲面，把每条曲线长度在所有双曲度量中的下确界组成 inf 谱，证明其增长为仅依赖 g 的指数级，改进此前双指数上界。
analysis.breakthrough: 把模空间曲线最小长度谱的增长上界降到指数尺度。
analysis.limitations: 长度的下确界遍历全部双曲度量，不是单个固定曲面的长度谱。
analysis.priorityReason: 双曲曲面模空间与曲线复杂度的计数改进。
